raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was delivered twice (02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-19), so about 326 transactions are re-sent with identical content, which the silver step never deduplicates. Deduplicating on txn_id after the POSTED filter, keeping the earliest ingest, should restore one row per transaction and correct the 2026-01-18 volume and the gold aggregates.","decision": "fix","confidence": 0.7,"pre_sql": [],"step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) = 1;"}}
